subject: Veridian vendor portal: remit re-point + PO contact update
messages:
From: Sana Malik <sana.malik@veridian.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Payments <payments@veridian.co>
Date: 2026-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to update remit account and PO contact for Veridian (vendor ID VERI-334)

Hi Marcus,

Hope you’re well — we recently completed a treasury migration and need Redwood to update our vendor record so that payments go to our new banking partner. While this is post-onboarding, we want to make the change cleanly to avoid payment delays. Summary: 

- New remit account: First Horizon (routing and account details provided in bank-letter attached)
- New AP email / PO contact: ap@veridian.co and PO contact name Sana Malik (I’ll attach a vCard)
- Updated legal address (headquarters moved): 420 Meridian Ave, Suite 210, Boston, MA 02118

Can you confirm what paperwork you need from us and the lead time to make the change in your system? Our preferred effective date is May 18 to align with our AR schedule.

Thanks — attaching the bank-letter and W-9 now.

Attachments (sent): bank-letter-veridian.pdf; W-9.pdf

Best,
Sana Malik
Head of Finance Operations
Veridian Labs
(sana.malik@veridian.co)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Malik <sana.malik@veridian.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update remit account and PO contact for Veridian (vendor ID VERI-334)

Hi Sana — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. We can make this change, but to avoid routing issues we need a couple of items completed before we update AP: 

1) Signed vendor supplement confirming the new bank details (scan or PDF with signature).
2) Original bank letter (on bank letterhead) — looks like you attached a copy, we'll need the bank-signed PDF you mentioned (bank-letter-veridian.pdf).
3) Confirmation of the primary PO contact (we can accept the vCard or a short email from your director approving the change).
4) Please confirm whether invoices will continue to be submitted to our PO system (PO@redwoodinference.com) or directly to payments@veridian.co for the foreseeable quarter so we can set routing rules.

Operational notes: 
- If we receive the signed supplement + bank letter by EOD May 6, AP can schedule the remit switch with a target effective date of May 18. 
- During the cutover we keep a two-week payable buffer to reprocess any payments that fall into the transition window.

I’ve copied Laura from AP to confirm the internal steps and Dev from procurement ops to update the vendor portal once we have the paperwork.

Action items for Veridian: signed vendor-supplement, bank letter on bank letterhead, vCard or confirmation email for PO contact, confirm invoice submission flow.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short checklist and a DocuSign link if you prefer e-signature.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
(marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com)
From: Sana Malik <sana.malik@veridian.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Payments <payments@veridian.co>
Date: 2026-05-02T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update remit account and PO contact for Veridian (vendor ID VERI-334)

Marcus — attaching the signed-supplement and the bank-signed confirmation. Also included the W-9 and a vCard for the new PO contact. Confirming answers inline: 

- Signed vendor supplement: attached (vendor-supplement-signed.pdf)
- Bank letter: attached (bank-letter-veridian.pdf)
- PO contact: Sana Malik, ap@veridian.co, vCard attached (new-po-contact.vcf) — you can treat this as the primary PO contact effective immediately.
- Invoice submission: invoices will continue to be sent to PO@redwoodinference.com for purchase orders; any invoice-only submissions should go to ap@veridian.co.

We completed e-signature internally and are attaching the final files. Please confirm receipt and whether AP needs any additional verification (micro-deposit, bank auth form, etc.).

Attachments: vendor-supplement-signed.pdf; bank-letter-veridian.pdf; W-9.pdf; new-po-contact.vcf

Thanks — looking forward to the confirmation of the May 18 effective date.

Best,
Sana
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Sana Malik <sana.malik@veridian.co>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-02T16:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update remit account and PO contact for Veridian (vendor ID VERI-334)

Thanks for the files, Sana — we got everything we need. Quick notes from AP: 

- Verified bank-letter and W-9; micro-deposit is not required for this bank (First Horizon) because we have a bank-signed confirmation.
- Vendor record will be updated in the vendor portal and payments routing will switch to the new account on 2026-05-18 EOD PST.
- We will keep prior account on file for two business cycles and flag any invoices hitting the old remit for manual re-routing during the 14-day buffer.
- PO contact updated in our system to Sana Malik (ap@veridian.co). We also added the vCard to your vendor profile.

Marcus / Dev — please deploy the portal change (portal vendor ID VERI-334) and confirm when the routing rule is active so we can close the ticket.

Sana — once routing is active we’ll send a confirmation email and a quick note to your payments inbox.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
(laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com)
